postTitle: I Don't Want To Say I Told You So, But I Kinda Did.
postSubject: Here we are. At the end of all things. I tried warning you, Scott. I tried to warn you all. And what happened? I was banned from ALL the FNaF groups. I told Scott to turn back, and he didn't, and NOW look what has happened. FNaF World is a hilarious colassal failure of a videogame. Look at all the most helpful reviews. I've loaded a bunch up, and none of them have been positive. I know there are more positive reviews, but those are just from the fanboys that will like anything with FNaF slapped on it. I told you you were going to run it into the ground, and that has now happened. And a toy line? Are you kidding me? Does anyone remember Slender? How popular that was? You know how many games they made to capitalize on the success? They made 2 Slender games. The original, and the sequel.I'm not even surprised this failed. And you can't fool anyone by saying, ''I was so excited that I released it a month early.'' That's what demos are for. And $10 is too much for an unfinished and sloppy product. If it's not finished, make it early access. The evidence is stacking against your claims. No, this game is the final product, and now you are trying to backpedal by saying it isn't finished. I, personally, don't buy that. And if anyone else is smart, they won't fall for it either. It's over Scott. You killed the FNaF franchise, and the worst part is that me and MANY OTHER PEOPLE tried to warn you, yet your wallet spoke louder than us and now it's come to bite you in the rear.I have screen-capped all the Helpful reviews so in case they mysteriously go missing, I will have  proof of their existance. I also heard a rumor you were going to start on a sequel to this game. I hope that's not true. I really, honestly, truely, am praying it's not true. Enough is enough. Five Nights at Freddy's and you have had your time in the spotlight, and it's time to move on and do other things. I implore you to move on if you have any respect for yourself or your fans. I'm not trying to be mean, I'm being dead serious. It's over. I will see the movie, but only because I support Gil Kenan as a director. The book you wrote? Why? What did that have to do with anything? I hope people will finally see you are milking this series now.I'm screencapping this post for proof. I have not at all violated the Steam terms of service, I've made no personal attacks, and I have used no swear words. Please, for the sake of your dignity, and your legacy, make like Elsa and Let it Go.
